participation.context: Tried the shoes on and took them off again until morning.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Told you to take a guard for the thistles, and to be back before half past six.
participation.name: Anne Shakespeare

participation.context: Brought the word, and offered the guard from the peg.
participation.name: Richard Shakespeare

participation.context: Took the shoes to grease the heel-seam.
participation.name: Joan Shakespeare

relations.quote: Master Quiney and Master Sturley sit down at half past six.

story.body: On the word from Bartholomew's boy, you tried the shoes, took the wide guard, and gave the shoes back to Joan. You left the bundle tied.

relations.quote: Master Quiney and Master Sturley sit down at half past six.

title: Tried the old shoes for six in the morning
